description: Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow.py. MUST: (1) authenticate via SNOW OAuth tokens retrieved from env SNOW_OAUTH_TOKEN or snow_oauth_token_file; (2) validate inbound webhook signature via X-SNOW-Signature header; (3) never accept unsigned webhooks — reject with HTTP 401; (4) write MCP approval decisions back to ServiceNow via write_service; (5) query mcp_decisions table for analyst APPROVED/CONDITIONAL before forwarding. Reads snow_connector.py and approval_workflow.py. ServiceNow OAuth2 token acquisition via env SNOW_INSTANCE, SNOW_CLIENT_ID, SNOW_CLIENT_SECRET. Output is a wiring module, not a daemon.
